_readme: Andon's catalogue: the causes (to file a complaint like a breakdown report) and the countermeasure ladder (from weakest to strongest). Read by andon.py and by the andon skill. Change a code here and it changes everywhere.

causes.name: Wrong
causes.when: It states or sends something false: a number, a date, a name, a fact made up or misread.

causes.name: Bad data
causes.when: It reasons correctly on bad material: data missing, stale, duplicated or attached to the wrong thing (CRM, transcript, link, folder).

causes.name: Broken
causes.when: It doesn't run: bug, crash, slowness, deliverable never produced, fix merged but never deployed.

causes.name: Noise
causes.when: Too many messages, too long, too often, or with nothing new: people stop reading.

causes.name: Form
causes.when: The substance is right but it reads badly: jargon, density, tone, length, the wrong voice.

causes.name: Silence
causes.when: It stays quiet where it should have spoken: a missed case, an absent alert, a question left unanswered.

causes.name: Off target
causes.when: It does well something nobody needs, or misses the real need: it adds work instead of removing it.

causes.name: Effort
causes.when: It asks too much of the human: typing, a field to fill in, clicks, fetching the information elsewhere.

causes.name: Wrong place
causes.when: The right thing in the wrong place, at the wrong time or for the wrong person.

causes.name: Trust
causes.when: It did or showed what it should not have: confidentiality, sending without agreement, acting outside its mandate.

levels.name: Instruction
levels.what: Change an instruction: prompt, skill, CLAUDE.md, playbook, memory. The weakest: a model can ignore it.

levels.name: Example
levels.what: Put the case into the suite: a regression test or eval case that reproduces the complaint and fails if it comes back.

levels.name: Guardrail
levels.what: Make the mistake impossible or blocking in code: validation before sending, a CI check, a threshold, a mechanical refusal.

levels.name: Mechanism
levels.what: Change how the system works: where the data comes from, when it speaks, where it lives, who does what.

levels.name: Standard
levels.what: Change the rule shared by every system (doctrine, bot template, global CLAUDE.md) when the cause shows up elsewhere.
